scope: complete PDF native-text access with two explicitly tagged image-table supplements; not faithful OCR of all figures or equations
native_math_limitations: Formula layout and superscripts may flatten.
Other raster figure contents are not guaranteed searchable.

corrections_to_machine_ocr: Preserved empty cells explicitly as [blank]; column relations reconstructed from image coordinates.
Column separators added to preserve alignment; all displayed numeric values retained.

limitations: Model-assisted visual transcription, not human gold.
Transcribed only two known image-only tables; other raster figures are not converted to searchable numeric data.
Native mathematical typography and equation layout can be flattened.
